title: On the Numerical Range of Linear Relations in Banach Spaces
summary: This paper is devoted to the study of the numerical range of linear relations in Banach spaces. We present a new definition adapted to the multivalued nature of linear relations and analyze its main properties. We establish spectral inclusion results showing that the spectrum is contained in the union of the closure of the numerical range of a linear relation and the numerical range of its Banach adjoint, together with resolvent estimates related to the distance to the numerical range.
